basic_info.description: Prime Pacific Heights! Views, views, views! The moment you step into this fabulous 3 bd/2 ba modern open concept condominium, you are welcomed by fabulous Golden Gate Bridge & bay views & lush greenery outlooks through large windows! The bay & greenery combination is stunning! The living room, dining room, kitchen, & 1 of the bedrooms showcase the wonderful GG bridge & bay views & have great light! The large inviting living room offers floor-to-ceiling windows framing the view. The view eat-in kitchen offers all the modern conveniences, including an abundance of counter & cabinet space, Gaggenau, Sub Zero, & Bosch appliances & a peninsula that provides seating for 3. The bright & airy kitchen opens flawlessly into the view dining area that can comfortably seat 8 to 10. The primary ensuite offers a fireplace & 3rd bedroom features a custom built-in desk & shelving. This beautiful unit boasts 1 car parking & a storage room. Located on one of the best blocks in Pacific Heights, this beautiful nine-unit elevator building features a fabulous roof deck with spectacular panoramic Bay views! Walk to Lafayette & Alta Plaza Parks & fabulous Chestnut, Union, & Fillmore street shops, restaurants & boutiques, Marina Green, & The Presidio! Close to top schools & transportation! 99 walk score!
